Software Geeks Move Differently

by Connor Kuljis

Today we are back with a different type of blog post. It's about how software engineers move differently.

The peak spirit or ethos I tap in to is to 'move different', meaing you don't listen to anyone else but yourself.

And I've noticed the most in the modern

You're not obligated to do anything for anyone.

  • If you studied a certain field and got a degree in it to please your parents or uncles, you must realise that your not obligated to go work dreading every day because of that.

Doing the best thing for yourself is how you help the people directly around you.
